dedupe_keys.name: ball screw drive surface defect dataset for classification

description: Tobias Schlagenhauf publishes 21,835 RGB images of ball-screw surfaces to classify pitting damage before machine-tool breakdown. KIT identifies 11,075 images without defects and the remaining images with pitting, all at 150 by 150 pixels. The documented creation period is 1 August 2020 to 12 June 2021, with publication on 17 June 2021. Physical site and geographical sampling coverage are not stated. The KIT record links the downloadable collection through RADAR4KIT and gives free access under CC BY-NC 4.0. A limitation is that some images were rotated ninety degrees during acquisition; filename markers distinguish rotation and normal versus pitted classes. Image balance should not be interpreted as an operational failure probability. Simulation uses include calibrating visual inspection classifiers and testing maintenance observation errors. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with machine-tool surface imagery. Earlier candidates were rejected only for lacking transport content, but industrial condition monitoring is within this review’s scope. No image files were downloaded.
